0022600202.text: The Sacramento Kings host the Miami Heat in their 10th game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 1-8 overall, 0-4 at home, and on a two-game losing streak, while Miami is 3-6 and has lost its last game. Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are all out for Sacramento, and Murray is averaging 7.0 points and 27.2 minutes per game this season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Sacramento's last meeting a 130-117 loss at home on January 20, 2026.
